# TreatStream triggers

## Authenticated

Runs when Cuebot has signed in to TreatStream successfully. Handy to confirm the sign-in worked.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `treatstream.authenticated`</small>

## Connected

Runs when Cuebot connects to TreatStream. Handy for a quick "all good" message or to switch something on.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |

<small>Type id: `treatstream.connected`</small>

## Disconnected

Runs when Cuebot loses or ends its connection to TreatStream. Handy to warn yourself that alerts have stopped.

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%service%` | The name of the service |
| `%reason%` | Why the connection ended |

<small>Type id: `treatstream.disconnected`</small>

## Treat

Runs when a viewer sends you a treat on TreatStream, like a pizza. Great for a thank-you message.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Treat** | Only run for one kind of treat, like "Pizza". Leave empty for any treat. |
| **Include test events** | Tick to also run for test events (made with a "send test" button). Untick to run only for real ones. Starts as: `true`. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | Who sent the treat |
| `%treat%` | What kind of treat it was |
| `%message%` | Their message |
| `%receiver%` | Who it was sent to |
| `%senderType%` | Where the sender is from, like Twitch |
| `%isTest%` | True when this is a test event, not a real one |

<small>Type id: `treatstream.treat`</small>
